meta.title: Measured Google rating + review count for located rival title-lender branches
meta.label: MEASURED — Google Places (New) Place Details rating + userRatingCount, joined onto the scout's rival place_ids. A SAMPLE (the located subset), not the full census. AutoX-branch reputation is NOT obtainable (our branches have no captured place_ids and are not findable by text search) — stated, not inferred.
